record.title: Screen recorder
record.description: Record an area, preview videos, or save recent replay footage.
record.hint: Drag and release to record an area, or choose a window to keep capturing it. Instant Replay buffers the current screen alongside recording and resumes automatically on launch when enabled. Saving continues buffering without a persistent overlay. Clips can be less than 5 seconds shorter than the selected duration.
record.beta_hint: GPU only. Tries vendor encoding and GPU image processing; unavailable features fall back to a compatible path with a reason.
record.select_hint: Drag and release to start, or click a window when window snapping is enabled. Esc or right-click cancels.
record.memory_hint: Compressed clips stay in RAM; video is written only when saving a replay. Limited capacity keeps a shorter recent history. The limit includes clips being saved, with headroom for recording to continue. Unsaved clips are lost on stop, crash or power loss. Encoder memory is additional, and Windows may use its paging file. Turn replay off before changing storage.
record.memory_limited: Buffer capacity was reached; the available replay history may be shorter.
record.memory_failed: Replay memory allocation failed. Free more memory, reduce bitrate or shorten replay duration, then try again.
record.dx12_hint: Compatible capture with DX12 processing and encoding supports fullscreen transitions and window recording. Currently requires a compatible NVIDIA GPU; falls back to DX11 when unavailable. The game can use a different graphics API.
record.dx12_fallback: DX12 is unavailable. Recording continues with DX11.
record.replay_not_ready: Instant Replay is not ready. Turn it on and allow frames to buffer.
